body:
Schema 21 acquisition tests still observed jobs and collection progress through Core after ADR 0002 moved them to Operational. Correct explicit store observations and obsolete mandatory continuation assertions while preserving committed domain resources, rejected-input absence, actual clocks, idempotent completion and selected coverage.

The shared fixture now reads jobs from Operational. Tests observe Core collection identity/evidence and Operational progress through independent snapshots without ATTACH, aliases or compatibility tables. Incomplete collections restart safely with fresh IDs; old partial evidence remains uncompleted; valid newer terminal collections can be reused. Retired `incremental_scans` checks assert schema absence alongside actual acquisition behavior. Production source and schemas are unchanged.

Validation:
- Original owned cohort: 71 passed, 172 failed (all 172 belong to the inherited 228 runtime failures).
- Final frozen source `76d3389`: **244 passed, 0 failed/errors/skips**, including a new positive/negative physical-boundary regression.
- All original nodes map to passing final nodes; JUnit and per-node journals reconcile exactly. The 332 executable inputs match the frozen source.
- Ruff check/format and the 1950-node historical disposition audit passed. Independent architecture and fixture reviewers reported no blocker; integrated independent execution is reported by the coordinator.
- Failed experiments, all five explicit rename mappings, per-node classification and artifact hashes are retained in `docs/implementation/evidence/schema21-collection-20261016/`.

This is owned-cohort acceptance. Full repository, P1–P6 and distribution verification is recorded in the dependent integration PR. Development CI is not full runtime acceptance.

Merge dependency: main → this PR → Operational job/Search correction → integration evidence. Independent of P7 #87/#88/#89. Owner merge authorization remains pending; no merge, activation or deployment was performed.
